caption:
Most owners can tell you what they spent on ads last month.

Few can tell you what it returned.

The Ad ROI Calculator takes four numbers you already know: ad spend, leads generated, close rate, average job value.

It runs them through a fixed model and hands back your cost per lead and a return-on-spend estimate you can hold up against what you're paying an agency or a platform.

Free, no signup, no card.

These are illustrative estimates built from your own numbers. Not a benchmark. Not a guarantee.
